question: Inventory service database choice. Priorities: operational calm, backups you trust, boring upgrades. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: PostgreSQL, Supabase, CockroachDB, PlanetScale, Oracle Database, Amazon Aurora, MariaDB, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: Fans like MariaDB JSON features; ops notes warn about vacuum/ops surprises at scale.
MySQL major-version upgrades were described as uneventful in an ops retrospective.
MariaDB query UX is pleasant; replica lag showed up under write bursts in one postmortem.
Oracle Database backup restores were rehearsed successfully by two teams this year.
PlanetScale is trendy; managed backups feel bolted on.

notes: Contested evidence: two competitors look stronger on stated priorities; principal only in mixed tradeoff notes. No answer-key ranking.
